summary: Tested iteration 15 removal of agency public page. Backend: 6/6 pytest passed - GET /api/agencies/{id}/public returns 404, /api/providers still includes verified agency companions (Sofia/Valentina/Amara), agency-owned provider detail endpoint works normally.
